confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and budget-accommodation anchors are moderately reliable. Alcohol anchors (beer, cocktail, wine) are lower confidence because alcohol is restricted and not served in many Fez establishments, and prices vary widely between medina riads and hotel bars. Cocktail and wine anchors use the local price relationship to beer (cocktail about 2.2x beer, wine glass about 1.8x beer) because direct knowledge is weak. FX: the 0.6955 USD_PER_AUD value for 2026-10-15 was taken from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA exchange-rates overview page. I did not open that page to verify the figure, so confirm it against the official RBA F11 data before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Scaled from general Moroccan medina-city pricing, positioned slightly below Marrakech and close to other mid-sized Moroccan tourist cities. Hostel and hotel anchors reflect Fez medina riad and guesthouse levels. Restaurant anchors reflect local medina and mid-range riad dining.
